action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: Partial item removal from a pending order is not supported; only item modification (exchange for another variant of the same product) or full order cancellation is allowed.
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: User requested to cancel (remove) three office items from a pending order without providing replacement items. Assistant attempted to use modify_pending_order_items with empty new_item_ids.
action_legality_checks.reasoning: The policy does not permit partial removal of items from a pending order without replacement. The modify_pending_order_items tool is only for exchanging items for other variants, not for removal. The attempted action violates policy and uses incorrect arguments.
action_legality_checks.correct_action: Inform the user that partial removal is not supported and offer to either exchange the items for other variants or cancel the entire order.
